title: No dialog when the toggle is off, when the member is already inactive, or on reactivation — assignments resurface immediately
preconditions: 1. ZZAUTOTEST staff member X is active WITHOUT the sales-rep toggle; ZZAUTOTEST rep Y (with assignments) is currently inactive.
steps: 1. Deactivate X and watch for a dialog.
2. Reactivate rep Y via the standard toggle and watch for a dialog; check Y's customer assignments afterwards.
expected: 1. For a staff member without the sales-rep toggle, the precondition check is skipped and no warning is shown.
2. Reactivation never shows the warning dialog (the flow does not apply to an already-inactive member).
3. After reactivation the assignments re-surface immediately with no extra action.
